title: Fix Even Numbers Sum
description: Fix the function to correctly calculate the sum of all even numbers in a given list.
test_code:
def test_sum_evens():
    assert sum_evens([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) == 12
    assert sum_evens([1, 3, 5]) == 0
    assert sum_evens([2, 4, 8]) == 14

title: Fix String Reversal
description: Fix the function so it properly reverses a given string.
test_code:
def test_reverse_string():
    assert reverse_string('hello') == 'olleh'
    assert reverse_string('ai') == 'ia'
    assert reverse_string('') == ''
